config.label: Existing workspace key
config.description: Existing workspace key. Unconfigured local STDIO can create provisional Shadow access on first evaluation; owned access is required for ERP.

config.label: Organization UUID that binds Protocol evaluation and evidence calls
config.description: Organization UUID that binds Protocol evaluation and evidence calls. The ERP guard instead authenticates request.tenant_id with the configured API key.

config.label: Optional HTTPS API origin or exact /aws gateway prefix
config.description: Optional HTTPS API origin or exact /aws gateway prefix. Defaults to https://api.decionis.com.

config.label: Optional private directory for persistent local trial credentials; defaults to ~/
config.description: Optional private directory for persistent local trial credentials; defaults to ~/.config/agentops (honoring XDG_CONFIG_HOME).

config.label: Set 0 to disable new local trial creation
config.description: Set 0 to disable new local trial creation. Existing stored credentials remain usable.
